question: Which park are situated within 190 kilometers following the north direction from Feather Factory Hotel, Long Island City, NY?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.94065 40.74418)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.94065 40.74418)',4326)::geography, 190000)
AND leisure = 'park'
AND ((degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 0.0 AND 22.5) OR (degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360));
